_note: Items. All names and numbers are original to this project [MODEL]. Canon facts used: carry capacity is an economic stat; a new archhuman has a backpack, not a storage ring (Brent 2026-09-23); satellites are items you find or buy, and a 1-star can use a 2-star satellite at full rate (Brent 2026-09-23). slot: back | satellite | trinket | '' (not equippable). stats are summed over equipped items: carry_capacity (kg), satellite_rate (essence/s), cost_mult (ability essence cost multiplier), reflux_shed_mult. Weapons (slot 'weapon') are held in the striking arm: melee_damage_mult, melee_cooldown_mult (below 1 = faster), melee_range_bonus (metres). They do nothing while that arm is lost. gear_sell_factor is what the merchant pays for gear; loot sells at full value. design/06 step 1 (approved by Brent 2026-10-12): slots 'body' and 'ranged'. armour is the percent of each hit a piece takes off (capped by balance.gear.armour_cap). A ranged weapon's shot does balance.ranged.ranged_damage x ranged_damage_mult every ranged_interval seconds out to ranged_range metres, for no essence. The draft catalogue in design/data-drafts/items-v2.json gives the Husk-Hide Jack 4 wound resistance as well; that stat is not read by the game until step 2, so it is left off the live item rather than listed and ignored. design/06 section 2, the paper doll (2026-10-12): the twelve slots are weapon (main hand), offhand, ranged, head, body, hands, feet, back, belt, satellite, trinket, trinket2 (trinket2 takes any 'trinket' item; the same item is never worn twice). The head, hands, feet, off-hand and belt pieces come from the draft catalogue with ONLY the stats the game reads: armour, cost_mult, reflux_shed_mult, and ranged_interval_mult (multiplies the time between shots; read in Player.ranged_interval). Left off because nothing reads them yet: wound_resist, poise, move_speed_mult, quick_slots, ammo_recover_add, and a glove's melee_cooldown_mult (weapon_stat only reads the main hand). Shields are not here at all - their whole effect is 'block', which is not built. The Rope Belt therefore does nothing yet and says so. kind 'scroll': an item that 'teaches' a skill - read from the pack, used up, only by a character with that skill's affinity; it is not loot (never sold by 'sell all loot'). shop_scrolls: the scrolls the merchant stocks; the shop shows only those this character could learn. Brent 2026-10-18: nothing pays cash. A kill leaves its kind's remains (enemies.json 'remains'); a passage pays its spoils at the exit as 'spoils' items, the most valuable first, as many as you can carry. Money comes only from selling in town. 2026-10-23 (the Stubble): the unstarred beasts' remains (hides, bone, meat, fat - the raw stock of Rendering and Leatherwork, design/12; recipes in crafting.json); kind 'curio': a rare thing found on a beast, only good for selling (loot, at full value; 'rarity' is a label); kind 'consumable' with 'use' {effect 'heal', amount, out_of_combat}: click it in the pack to use it (Player.use_consumable). Consumables are not loot (never bulk-sold).

canvas_pack.name: Canvas Pack
canvas_pack.desc: A cheap backpack. Everything you own fits, for now.

delver_frame.name: Delver's Frame
delver_frame.desc: A load-bearing frame built for hauling corpses out.

dim_mote.name: Dim Mote
dim_mote.desc: A one-star satellite. It trickles essence into you whether you ask or not.

paired_mote.name: Paired Mote
paired_mote.desc: A two-star satellite. Rank does not matter to the wearer - only the price does.

river_stone.name: River Stone Charm
river_stone.desc: Water abilities cost a tenth less essence.

cooling_coil.name: Cooling Coil
cooling_coil.desc: Reflux bleeds off half again as fast.

husk_plate.name: Husk Plate
husk_plate.desc: A slab of invader hide. Tanners buy it.

sinew_cord.name: Sinew Cord
sinew_cord.desc: Tough, stringy, sells by the length.

serrated_dagger.name: Serrated Dagger
serrated_dagger.desc: An invader's blade. Light, quick, and legal to keep when it comes out of a passage.

brute_tusk.name: Brute Tusk
brute_tusk.desc: Heavy. Worth it if you can still walk.

commander_sigil.name: Commander's Sigil
commander_sigil.desc: Proof you put one down. Collectors pay.

golden_seed.name: Golden Grass Seed
golden_seed.desc: Passage flora. The rich plant it to show off.

iron_knuckles.name: Iron Knuckles
iron_knuckles.desc: Banded iron over the fist. Honest work.

invader_cleaver.name: Invader's Cleaver
invader_cleaver.desc: Too heavy for the thing that carried it. Slow, and it ends arguments.

commander_blade.name: Commander's Blade
commander_blade.desc: Long, balanced, and made for someone taller than you.

patched_coat.name: Patched Coat
patched_coat.desc: More patch than coat. It is yours.

cord_sling.name: Cord Sling
cord_sling.desc: A cord, a pouch, and whatever is on the ground.

padded_jack.name: Padded Jack
padded_jack.desc: Quilted linen. Breathes, which matters more than you would think.

husk_hide_jack.name: Husk-Hide Jack
husk_hide_jack.desc: Invader hide, badly cured. It kept one of them alive for a while.

oilcloth_hood.name: Oilcloth Hood
oilcloth_hood.desc: Sheds rain and, for reasons nobody has written down, a little heat.

boiled_cap.name: Boiled Cap
boiled_cap.desc: Leather cooked until it gave up being skin.

work_gloves.name: Work Gloves
work_gloves.desc: Split palm, one finger missing. The glove's, so far.

hide_bracers.name: Hide Bracers
hide_bracers.desc: Something to put between an edge and the arm you need.

street_boots.name: Street Boots
street_boots.desc: Resoled twice. The uppers are original.

hobnailed_boots.name: Hobnailed Boots
hobnailed_boots.desc: They grip. You stay where you stood.

chalk_slate.name: Chalk Slate
chalk_slate.desc: Your working, written out where you can see it. Fewer mistakes, less waste.

runesetters_slate.name: Runesetter's Slate
runesetters_slate.desc: Someone else's working. Theirs was better.

rope_belt.name: Rope Belt
rope_belt.desc: Holds your trousers up. One day it will hold one thing besides.

quiver_belt.name: Quiver Belt
quiver_belt.desc: The next one is always where your hand already is.

scroll_undertow.name: Scroll: Undertow
scroll_undertow.desc: Teaches Undertow to someone with the water affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

skirmisher_mask.name: Skirmisher's Mask
skirmisher_mask.desc: A pale lacquered mask, still warm. Collectors and the curious pay for them.

rampart_bowstave.name: Rampart Bowstave
rampart_bowstave.desc: Seasoned wood under the grime. A bowyer will want it.

harrier_pelt.name: Harrier Pelt
harrier_pelt.desc: Short, coarse, and the colour of dusk. Furriers buy them.

brute_hide.name: Brute Hide
brute_hide.desc: A slab of hide as thick as a door. Worth a great deal to anyone who can carry it.

pavise_boss.name: Pavise Boss
pavise_boss.desc: The iron boss from a body-length shield. Smiths buy the metal.

censer_ash.name: Censer Ash
censer_ash.desc: A pouch of what was burning. Apothecaries argue over what it is good for.

war_drumhead.name: War Drumhead
war_drumhead.desc: Stretched skin, painted. It still hums when you touch it.

spoils_strongbox.name: Sealed Strongbox
spoils_strongbox.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics.name: Case of Relics
spoils_relics.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage.name: Passage Salvage
spoils_salvage.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

wren_down.name: Wren Down
wren_down.desc: A twist of soft breast feathers. Stuffers and fletchers buy it by the handful.

kettle_shell.name: Kettle-Beetle Shell
kettle_shell.desc: A dented coppery dome. Ground down it is bone meal; whole, children use them as helmets.

hound_pelt.name: Ditch-Hound Pelt
hound_pelt.desc: A patchy dun pelt. Scraped and tanned it makes a serviceable leather.

game_haunch.name: Haunch of Game
game_haunch.desc: Rangy meat off a beast of the Stubble. Rendered down, the fat makes tallow.

hound_fang.name: Hound Fang
hound_fang.desc: A long yellow canine. Four of them grind to a measure of bone meal.

hog_hide.name: Burr-Hog Hide
hog_hide.desc: Thick hide with the burrs still matted into the bristles. Worth the scraping.

hog_fatback.name: Hog Fatback
hog_fatback.desc: A slab of back fat. Rendered, it is tallow by the bucket.

hog_tusk.name: Burr-Hog Tusk
hog_tusk.desc: A short, upcurved tusk, worn sharp on the inside edge.

wirehorn_hide.name: Wirehorn Hide
wirehorn_hide.desc: A long, thin-haired hide from a beast of the power-line verge.

wirehorn_antler.name: Wirehorn Antler
wirehorn_antler.desc: A branching antler, scored where wire was wound round it.

gleaner_hoard.name: Gleaner's Hoard
gleaner_hoard.desc: Whatever a Gleaner had picked up: buttons, nails, a tooth. Sold by the bag.

lurker_jaw.name: Sod-Lurker Jaw
lurker_jaw.desc: A jaw built to close upward. Bonesetters use the teeth as pegs.

lurker_blubber.name: Lurker Blubber
lurker_blubber.desc: Pale fat from under a Sod-Lurker's crust. It renders down clean.

thornback_hide.name: Thornback Hide
thornback_hide.desc: Most of a Thornback's back, spines and all. More than a starting pack holds.

thornback_horn.name: Thornback Horn
thornback_horn.desc: A grazer's horn, worn smooth on one side from rubbing on stones.

thornback_suet.name: Thornback Suet
thornback_suet.desc: Hard white fat from round the kidneys. Rendered, a great deal of tallow.

wren_glint.name: Wren's Glint
wren_glint.desc: A bright thing a wren had hidden: a ring-pull, a lens, once a tooth with a gold cap. A curio; collectors pay.

scald_gland.name: Scald Gland
scald_gland.desc: The sac a Kettle Beetle boils its water in. Apothecaries argue over what it is good for.

copper_tangle.name: Tangle of Copper Wire
copper_tangle.desc: Old wire off a Wirehorn's antlers, green with age. Someone strung it once between the poles.

lurker_pearl.name: Lurker Pearl
lurker_pearl.desc: A stone polished round and dark in a Sod-Lurker's gut. A curio; it fetches a good price.

thornback_heartstone.name: Thornback Heartstone
thornback_heartstone.desc: A smooth, banded stone from a Thornback's stomach. Rare; collectors and charm-makers both bid.

field_dressing.name: Field Dressing
field_dressing.desc: A pad and a bandage. Click it in your pack to bind a cut: 15 health, but only out of a fight.

exit_rewards._note: Per-person reward at the exit, scaled to how far you got (canon: contribution-scaled). rolls = walls cleared / walls_per_roll, +bonus_rolls_full_clear on a full clear.
